description: The .ksplat files Chaya publishes and its viewer loads. Derived from the pinned viewer library's own reader (SplatBuffer.parseHeader, parseSectionHeaders, calculateComponentStorage, KSplatLoader.checkVersion in build/gaussian-splats-3d.module.js) and narrowed to the one layout the worker writes and apps/web/lib/ksplat-compat.test.ts proves. Checked by the worker before upload (chaya_worker.ksplat.validate), by the API before publishing (dev.chaya.api.pipeline.KsplatValidator) and by the viewer before loading (apps/web/lib/ksplat-validation.ts); each has a test that its constants equal these. See packages/contracts/viewer/README.md.
